datasets.name: fin_kpi
queryLines: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND coalesce(dt_vencimento, dt_emissao) BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim), f AS (SELECT FORNECEDOR, sum(saldo) AS s FROM t WHERE grupo = 'Efetivo' GROUP BY FORNECEDOR), -- Indice Herfindahl-Hirschman (0-10000): > 1500 = concentracao moderada, > 2500 = alta h AS (SELECT round(sum(power(try_divide(s, tot), 2)) * 10000, 0) AS hhi FROM (SELECT s, sum(s) OVER () AS tot FROM f)) SELECT sum(saldo) AS saldo_total, sum(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Efetivo' THEN saldo END) AS saldo_efetivo, sum(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Efetivo' AND dias_atraso > 0 THEN saldo END) AS saldo_vencido, try_divide(sum(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Efetivo' AND dias_atraso > 0 THEN saldo END), sum(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Efetivo' THEN saldo END)) AS pct_vencido, sum(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Provisorio (PR)' THEN saldo END) AS saldo_provisorio, count(*) AS qtd_titulos, (SELECT hhi FROM h) AS hhi_fornecedores FROM t

datasets.name: fin_aging
queryLines: SELECT faixa, grupo, sum(saldo) AS saldo, count(*) AS qtd_titulos FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND coalesce(dt_vencimento, dt_emissao) BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY faixa, grupo ORDER BY faixa

datasets.name: fin_fluxo
queryLines: SELECT date_trunc('WEEK', dt_vencimento) AS semana, grupo, sum(saldo) AS saldo FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND coalesce(dt_vencimento, dt_emissao) BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim AND dt_vencimento BETWEEN current_date() AND date_add(current_date(), 84) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: fin_pareto
queryLines: WITH f AS (SELECT FORNECEDOR AS fornecedor, sum(saldo) AS saldo, count(*) AS titulos FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND coalesce(dt_vencimento, dt_emissao) BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim AND grupo = 'Efetivo' GROUP BY FORNECEDOR), r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY saldo DESC) AS ranking, try_divide(saldo, sum(saldo) OVER ()) AS pct, try_divide(sum(saldo) OVER (ORDER BY saldo DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), sum(saldo) OVER ()) AS pct_acumulado FROM f) SELECT *, CASE WHEN pct_acumulado <= 0.8 THEN 'A' WHEN pct_acumulado <= 0.95 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS classe FROM r WHERE ranking <= 30 ORDER BY ranking

datasets.name: fin_pag
queryLines: WITH m AS ( SELECT mes, sum(PAGO) AS valor_pago, count(DISTINCT REC) AS titulos, percentile_approx(prazo_dias, 0.5) AS prazo_mediano_dias, try_divide(sum(pago_atraso), sum(PAGO)) AS pct_pago_em_atraso, sum(JUROS + MULTA) AS juros_multa FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_pagamentos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND mes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mes), mm AS (SELECT *, avg(valor_pago) OVER (ORDER BY mes ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS media_movel_3m FROM m) SELECT * FROM mm WHERE mes BETWEEN date_trunc('MONTH', :data_inicio) AND :data_fim ORDER BY mes

datasets.name: fin_cc
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo, sum(saldo) AS saldo, count(*) AS titulos FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND coalesce(dt_vencimento, dt_emissao) BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim AND grupo = 'Efetivo' GROUP BY centro_custo ORDER BY saldo DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: fin_pag_cc
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo, sum(PAGO) AS valor_pago, count(DISTINCT REC) AS titulos FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_pagamentos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY centro_custo ORDER BY valor_pago DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: fin_ccs
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo FROM (SELECT 'Todos' AS centro_custo UNION SELECT centro_custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos UNION SELECT centro_custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_pagamentos) WHERE centro_custo IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN centro_custo = 'Todos' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, centro_custo

datasets.name: filiais
queryLines: SELECT filial FROM (SELECT 'Todas' AS filial UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_titulos UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_fin_pagamentos) WHERE filial IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN filial = 'Todas' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, filial

lines: **Como ler:** os títulos **provisórios (PR)** são previsões e ficam separados do saldo **efetivo**. O *aging* mostra quanto do saldo está vencido e há quanto tempo.
O **HHI** mede a concentração da dívida por fornecedor (0 a 10.000; acima de 2.500 = alta). O **Pareto** mostra quantos fornecedores somam 80% do saldo (classe A).
**Filtros:** o período vale para o vencimento dos títulos em aberto e para a data dos pagamentos. O centro de custo é o principal do título (o de maior valor no rateio).
